messages.subject: rapache with Drupal
messages.body_plain: I am considering creating a Drupal module to interface to the R stats package - for analysis, etc. Drupal is written in PHP and I was wondering what the advice would be for the interface. I see several posts here concerning how to call rapache from PHP, but then I also see the rook/rRack web service (https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/rRack) that apparently can interface to R via a web service. There are already web service modules for Drupal, so I am wondering if it might be more straightforward to go that route. Any ideas about this from anyone?
